international.title: Youth unemployment plan could cut welfare bill before election but overall savings will take years, Milburn says – UK politics live
international.summary: Long-awaited report on Neets will be published this morning as author acknowledges there will be initial costs Milburn urges Burnham to spend billions on ‘new deal’ for young people Alan Milburn told Sky News this morning that Labour MPs have so far welcomed his proposals. When Keir Starmer’s government proposed cutting disability benefits last year, there was a huge backbench rebellion and it was forced to back down. Labour is what it says on the tin. It’s the party of work. It’s not the party of welfare and of benefits. There will be some young people who are worse off at least initially as a consequence of benefit changes. But in the end, the best thing for people is to get them into work. There’s so many young people, for example, who come into the welfare system who frankly shouldn’t be there. It’s not inevitable that if somebody has got anxiety or depression or moderate ADHD, that somehow we should be saying to them, ‘What can’t you do?’ Continue reading...
